item.name: Login with pharmacy username and password(encoded).

request.name: Login with pharmacy username and password(encoded).

description.content: To login into MedAdvisor's system, send a POST request to /loginthirdparty and provide userName and password which is encoded by Base64-encoded UTF8 string. MedAdvisor will provide integrators with a clientId and a clientSecret. Consequently, MedAdvisor is going to return a token, which is used for authentication purposes in APIs requiring token-based authentication.

item.name: Retrieve details of a electronic prescription from PDS, given a EScript token

request.name: Retrieve details of a electronic prescription from PDS, given a EScript token

description.content:
Patient is going to transfer this token, medication, patient information... from Mobile Patient App to MedAdvisor. 
During the MedAdvisor's process, patient can look into the information about medication, quantity, status... in Mobile Patient App, by making an API call GET /escript/{token} to retrieve all the information mentioned above. 
Integrators put the token of the dispensation into parameters request, MedAdvisor responses dispense information
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
